_comment: Priority definitions sent to Jev. Edit the descriptions to match how YOU think about your inbox. Order matters: lowest to highest.

levels.junk: Marketing, newsletters, cold sales outreach, promotions, spam, or anything the recipient never needs to read.
levels.low: Automated notifications and FYI messages that need no reply: ticket updates, system reports, calendar acceptances, receipts, quarantine digests, group threads the recipient is only copied on.
levels.medium: A real person wrote this and a reply or small action is expected eventually, but nothing is time-sensitive. Routine questions, scheduling, status updates.
levels.high: A real person needs something from the recipient specifically, and it should be handled today or tomorrow. Direct questions, requests for a decision, follow-ups on something overdue, customer or partner asks.
levels.urgent: Needs attention right now. Production or customer-facing problems, escalations, someone blocked and waiting on the recipient, explicit same-day deadlines, angry or frustrated customers or partners.

thresholds._comment: Jev confidence below min_confidence triggers the rule-based fallback and marks the email for review.

signals._comment: Extra yes/no questions asked alongside priority. Used by the fallback rules and shown in the dashboard. Keys are fixed; feel free to reword the questions.
signals.needs_reply: The sender is waiting on a reply from the recipient personally.
signals.action_requested: The sender asks the recipient to do something specific.
signals.automated: This was generated by a system, tool, or mailing list rather than written by a person to the recipient.
signals.external_business: The sender is an external customer, partner, or vendor contact rather than a colleague.
signals.escalation: The sender sounds frustrated, is escalating, or says something is blocked or broken.
signals.recipient_only_copied: The recipient is copied for visibility and nobody is asking them for anything.

time_sensitivity_levels: No deadline or time pressure at all
Should be handled within the week
Should be handled today or tomorrow
Needs to be handled right now
